## Research team and collaboration

These research activities are carried out within
the [Animal and Food Genomics Group](https://site.unibo.it/animal-and-food-genomics/en)
at the University of Bologna, led by
[Prof. Luca Fontanesi](https://www.unibo.it/sitoweb/luca.fontanesi/en), and the 
Iowa State University, [Juan Steibel](https://www.ans.iastate.edu/people/juan-steibel)'s group.


My contributions are presented within this
collaborative research context.


## Project overview

ABPhenomics aims to integrate digital and
molecular phenotyping approaches to investigate
pig behaviour and support welfare-oriented
genomic selection.

The project combines AI-based analysis of video
and sensor data with metabolomic profiling to
characterize behavioural and molecular phenotypes.

The integration of these data sources is intended
to investigate relationships between behaviour,
metabolic variation and genomic information.

## My research contribution

As the MSCA Postdoctoral Fellow, my planned
research activities include:

- Development and application of AI-based
  computational pipelines for behavioural
  phenotyping using video and sensor data.
- Identification and characterization of
  metabolomic profiles associated with
  behavioural phenotypes in pigs.
- Integration of digital and molecular
  phenotypes with genomic information.
- Investigation of potential applications
  to genomic selection for animal welfare.

These activities represent the planned
scientific work of the fellowship.
